import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

data = input().split()
nVal, mVal, modVal = map(int, data[:3])
invMod = modVal - 2

fact = [1] * (nVal + 1)
for i in range(1, nVal + 1):
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % modVal

invFact = [1] * (nVal + 1)
invFact[nVal] = power(fact[nVal], invMod, modVal)
for i in range(nVal - 1, -1, -1):
    invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % modVal

CArr = [[0] * (nVal + 1) for _ in range(nVal + 1)]
CArr[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, nVal + 1):
    CArr[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        CArr[i][j] = (CArr[i - 1][j - 1] + CArr[i - 1][j]) % modVal

fArr = [0] * (mVal + 1)
gArr = [0] * (mVal + 1)
fArr[0] = 1
gArr[0] = 0

for i in range(1, mVal + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        sumS = (j * (j - 1) // 2 + (i - j + 1) * (i - j) // 2) % modVal
        fArr[i] = (fArr[i] + fArr[j - 1] * fArr[i - j] % modVal * (i + 1) % modVal * CArr[i - 1][j - 1]) % modVal
        gArr[i] = (gArr[i] + ((gArr[j - 1] * fArr[i - j] + fArr[j - 1] * gArr[i - j]) % modVal * (i + 1) + fArr[j - 1] * fArr[i - j] % modVal * sumS) % modVal * CArr[i - 1][j - 1]) % modVal

maxLimit2 = min(mVal, nVal - mVal + 1)
hArr = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(mVal + 1)] for _ in range(maxLimit2 + 1)]
hArr[0][0][0] = 1

for i in range(maxLimit2):
    for j in range(mVal):
        for k in range(1, mVal - j + 1):
            tempF = fArr[k] * CArr[j + k][j] % modVal
            hArr[i + 1][j + k][0] = (hArr[i + 1][j + k][0] + hArr[i][j][0] * tempF) % modVal
            hArr[i + 1][j + k][1] = (hArr[i + 1][j + k][1] + hArr[i][j][1] * tempF) % modVal
            hArr[i + 1][j + k][1] = (hArr[i + 1][j + k][1] + hArr[i][j][0] * gArr[k] % modVal * CArr[j + k][j]) % modVal

answerVal = 0
for i in range(1, maxLimit2 + 1):
    answerVal = (answerVal + hArr[i][mVal][1] * CArr[nVal - mVal + 1][i]) % modVal

print(answerVal % modVal)
